# qoregeo

> Zero-dependency, pure-Python GIS toolkit (Python 3.10+): distances, bearings, buffers, point-in-polygon, intersections, area/length, nearest-neighbour and attribute filters over CSV/GeoJSON, interactive OpenStreetMap maps and heatmaps, static PNG/SVG map images and OpenStreetMap geocoding. It also has a CLI, a zero-dependency MCP server and an Agent Skill for AI assistants.

Install with `pip install qoregeo` (or run `uvx qoregeo …`). Python API: `from qoregeo import GeoEngine`; points are `(lat, lng)` (or `{"lat": …, "lng": …}` dicts), GeoJSON coordinates are `[lng, lat]`. MCP server: `qoregeo mcp` (stdio; tools take `{"lat", "lng"}` objects; files confined to a root folder; geocoding only with `--allow-network` or `--geocoder-url`). HTML maps use OpenStreetMap tiles by default, which need the page served over http: `qoregeo serve map.html` or `geo.show()` (in a script both serve until Ctrl+C). Only `tiles="satellite"`, `"topo"`, `"osm-de"` and `"none"` work when the file is opened from disk.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/README.md): installation, full Python API, maps, CLI, MCP client setup
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/skills/qoregeo/SKILL.md): when and how an agent should use qoregeo (CLI, MCP, Python)
- [Python API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/skills/qoregeo/references/python-api.md): every GeoEngine method and parameter
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/skills/qoregeo/references/recipes.md): store locator, delivery zones, geocoding a CSV, route corridors

## Integration

- [MCP tool registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/qoregeo/tools.py): tool names, JSON schemas and handlers (`tool_definitions("anthropic" | "openai" | "mcp")`)
- [Claude API example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/examples/claude_tools.py): qoregeo tools in a Claude tool-use loop
- [Contributor guide for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosekarmegam/qoregeo/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, checks, layout
